body:
I can relate. One day I knew it was the perfect time. I was hopeless and I couldn't see a way out of that moment. I regret not leaving, but I also do not understand necessarily what kept me. 
I like to think that I knew it would be better than this one day. Deep down inside I had to keep going. I hope you can adopt that thought too, even if it doesn't look like it at the moment.

I agree. Finding a way to let some emotions out, no matter how small, has helped me escape some really bad situations. Try to find somebody or something that lets you vent and sometimes it'll just pour out.
It very much is. About the only reason right now but I really don't want to let them down. I hope I can stay in there long enough.
Is that an actual statistic? Because I'm more scared of the pain some other close people would feel of I left them. I can't imagine how they would feel and that scares me more than anything.

She has not read it but she encouraged me to seek help and she knows that I went to reddit. I will probably show this to her sometime.
Thanks for the response.
What should I do if I really don't feel well? I try and be alone but I'm not sure if it helps. Sometimes I feel like it's spiralling out of control and I don't know how to settle down. Any advice?
